take.text: Real house/techno pedigree stacks up fast this weekend — Moodymann tonight, Joris Voorn and Marques Wyatt next Friday, DJ Bone twice.

festivals.name: Daisy Chain Fields (Olivia Rodrigo)
festivals.location: Great Park Live, Irvine (OC — ~45 mi, worth the drive)
festivals.why: Olivia Rodrigo's first festival — a one-day, all-women lineup (Chappell Roan, Doechii, Mitski, The Breeders, Bikini Kill, Garbage, Santigold + special guests Stevie Nicks, Karen O, Sarah McLachlan), 100% of net proceeds to women/girls nonprofits. Off the core house/techno lane, but a marquee must-know — and squarely on-taste for the Lori profile (she tracks Olivia Rodrigo + Mitski). Sold out; only path in now is the L.A. Works volunteer-drive ticket lottery (125 pairs) or resale.

festivals.name: CRSSD Festival — Fall 2026
festivals.why: SD is a drive, but this is festival-tier and on-taste — Disclosure, Chris Lake, Groove Armada (DJ set), Helena Hauff, Ben UFO, I Hate Models, Mathame, Carlita, salute. House/ techno/melodic, European lean, waterfront, 21+. NOTE: same weekend as Portola (SF) — can't do both; pick one.

festivals.name: Portola 2026
festivals.why: THE one for you — electronic-forward with DESPACIO (James Murphy + 2ManyDJs sound system), Four Tet, Soulwax, Groove Armada, DJ Shadow, Fatboy Slim, Skepta, plus Robyn, Tiësto, Swedish House Mafia. European/house energy in a warehouse-pier setting. 2-day ~$380.

festivals.name: Coachella 2027
festivals.why: Advance GA already sold out (~$549–599); lineup typically drops Sept 2026–Jan 2027. Worth tracking the lineup announce to decide if a resale is worth it.

festivals.name: GALA Festival (London) — 2027 edition
festivals.why: Quintessential European house/disco day-fest (2026: Seth Troxler, Todd Terje, Call Super, DJ Seinfeld). On-taste, but not timely — only bubble up when 2027 presale/lineup drops.

dining.name: Mírate
dining.notes: Multi-level rooftop, Tulum-jungle candlelight; bar voted Best in California. Strong chic/date-night + birthday pick. Eastside.

dining.name: Wilde's
dining.notes: Tiny candlelit British bistro/wine bar; bakery-cafe by day. Intimate date-night; tables hard — Notify/bar seats. Eastside.

dining.name: Cafe Stella
dining.notes: Reopened after 2024 closure; slimmed menu — steak au poivre, frisée, frozen-lemon sorbet. Sunset Junction, home turf.

dining.name: Rasarumah
dining.notes: Eastside hotspot (Variety also flagged it). Confirm exact address/neighborhood next pass.

dining.name: Dunsmoor
dining.notes: Restored 1920s building around a huge wood-burning hearth. Eastside, on-profile for a special night.

dining.name: Yess
dining.notes: Grew out of the Yess Aquatic seafood truck. Chef Junya Yamasaki — confirm details next pass.

dining.name: Sushi Nakazawa
dining.notes: Omakase from a Jiro Ono protégé; NYC import's LA debut. Neighborhood unconfirmed.

dining.name: Hermon's
dining.notes: Refreshed chophouse from the Found Oyster team — martinis, pull-apart garlic bread, pasta vongole. Confirm neighborhood.

dining.name: Mish
dining.notes: New-wave deli on La Brea — wood-fired bagels, shakshuka with challah, pastrami reuben on schmaltz-griddled rye.

dining.name: Asadero
dining.notes: Above-average taco stand — smoky asada from a chef who left corporate kitchens. Confirm neighborhood.

dining.name: Amiguita
dining.notes: On the Resy Hit List; details unconfirmed — fill in cuisine/neighborhood next pass.

dining.name: Pasjoli
dining.notes: Refined French bistro, Chef Dave Beran (ex-Alinea). Westside — special-occasion, not walkable.

dining.name: Kassi
dining.notes: Greek-Med rooftop in Venice — mezze, lamb chops, grilled whole fish. Westside.

dining.name: San Laurel
dining.notes: Spanish-inflected dining high in the InterContinental DTLA (José Andrés group).

dining.name: Calabra
dining.notes: Mediterranean rooftop atop the Santa Monica Proper — charred flatbreads, mezze, grilled fish.

dining.name: Found Oyster
dining.notes: Tiny, buzzy seafood bar — clam cakes, chicken-fried oysters. Walk-in/bar; parent of Hermon's. Home turf.

dining.name: Bar Restaurant
dining.notes: Pink-hued, 'strange and fantastic' modern French. Intimate date-night; books up. Sunset Junction, walkable.

dining.name: Sogo Roll Bar
dining.notes: Handroll bar from the Sushi Note team — creative, high-quality fish. Counter seats. Eastside.

dining.name: Lolo Wine Bar
dining.notes: Low-key neighborhood wine bar with a great patio + shareable pasta. Walkable from home.

dining.name: Marco Polo
dining.notes: Outdoor-focused Italian — linguini vongole, gin-arugula cocktails. Patio date-night. Home turf.

dining.name: Clark Street Bakery
dining.notes: Echo Park bakery — caramelized kouign-amann, Nordic breakfast platters. Daytime/casual.

dining.name: Kismet Rotisserie
dining.notes: Casual rotisserie next to Kismet — roast chicken on pita, veg sides. Easy weeknight. Eastside.

dining.name: Jeff's Table
dining.notes: Cult deli hidden behind a liquor store — pastrami, specialty turkey. Lunch. Eastside.

dining.name: Yang's Kitchen
dining.notes: Order-at-counter Taiwanese-Chinese — braised pork rice, beef scallion wraps. SGV-adjacent.

dining.name: Sonmari
dining.notes: Silver Lake handroll spot — inventive DIY rolls (gochujang eel, 'banh mi' albacore). Walkable.

dining.name: Bar Di Bello
dining.notes: Low-lit Milanese-style aperitivo bar — cutlets, branzino, antipasti. Date-night. Home turf.

dining.name: Holbox
dining.notes: Game-changing Mexican seafood stall in Mercado La Paloma — aguachiles, tostadas. Michelin Bib-tier value (confirm). Walk-up.

dining.name: Quarter Sheets
dining.notes: Thick pan-style pizza + great wine list. Bib Gourmand value. Echo Park — walkable from home.

dining.name: Pizzeria Bianco
dining.notes: Chris Bianco's LA outpost (Row DTLA) — among the country's best pizza. Bib Gourmand. Confirm exact address.

dining.name: Sushi Note
dining.notes: Sushi-and-wine bar (team behind Sogo Roll Bar). Valley — a destination, not walkable.

dining.name: Santo
dining.notes: Japanese-Mexican nigiri/handrolls + sake & wine, Sunset Junction. Home turf; next to Bar Seco. (Santō)

dining.name: Bar Seco
dining.notes: Natural wine bar + small plates (CDMX/Madrid/Japan), spills onto Sunset. Walk-in/sidewalk seats. Next to Santo. (aka Seco)

dining.name: Superba
dining.notes: ARI'S ABSOLUTE FAVORITE — food + ambiance, the patio especially (also great inside). Superba Food + Bread, Lincoln Blvd. Westside — worth the drive.

dining.name: L&E Oyster Bar
dining.notes: Silver Lake oyster bar; the upstairs bar is the chill walk-in move. Home turf.

dining.name: Pijja Palace
dining.notes: Indian-Italian sports bar — pizza, pasta, cricket on the TVs. Very popular (hard rez / walk-in bar). Silver Lake, home turf.

dining.name: Night + Market Song
dining.notes: Kris Yenbamroong's fiery northern Thai on Sunset. Walk-in friendly. Home turf.

dining.name: Momed
dining.notes: Mediterranean — mezze, wraps, bowls. Atwater Village (also Beverly Hills). Eastside, easy.

dining.name: Bar Siesta
dining.notes: New Spanish tapas + all-Spanish wine bar (Heather Sperling team). On-taste wine bar, home turf.

dining.name: Atrium
dining.notes: Playful, vaguely-French cooking from Douglas Rankin in the old Malo space, Sunset Junction. New. Home turf.

dining.name: Bowery Bungalow
dining.notes: Modern Mediterranean from George Abou-Daoud in the former Sompun Thai. New, home turf.

dining.name: Frank n Franks
dining.notes: Sandwich spot from a Howlin' Ray's vet. Casual lunch, Chinatown — eastside-adjacent.

events.title: WORK x SKULLDUGGERY present: Alan Fitzpatrick, Anastasia Giovani, & Greg Downey
events.organizers: Work X Skullduggery, 6AM Group, Synthetik Minds
events.detail: This is a lineup that sits squarely on the trance into techno axis as Alan Fitzpatrick's style of big-room club debuts at WORK.

artist_notes.name: Alan Fitzpatrick
artist_notes.note: UK techno heavyweight and founder of We Are The Brave — driving, peak-time techno that tours the same circuit as Adam Beyer/Drumcode-tier bills; a legit headliner in the European techno lane.

artist_notes.name: Anastasia Giovani
artist_notes.note: SoCal-raised, now a fixture of LA's underground techno scene (SXTCY resident, founder of the VSCRL event series) — dark, textured, experimental techno sets.

artist_notes.name: Greg Downey
artist_notes.note: Belfast-born DJ/producer and founder of the Skullduggery label — started in trance (his 'Stadium' was Mixmag's Cream Ibiza anthem of 2008) before moving into deeper underground techno via his R.I.C.O alias.

enrichment.curator_note: A TBA-warehouse techno bill anchored by Alan Fitzpatrick's proper peak-time European sound, with Greg Downey's own Skullduggery imprint and LA underground regular Anastasia Giovani rounding it out — a real late one if you're up for it.
enrichment.description: TBA-location late-night techno party (WORK x Skullduggery) with Alan Fitzpatrick, Anastasia Giovani, Greg Downey, 11pm.

verdict.why: Alan Fitzpatrick is a real Drumcode-tier UK techno headliner running his own night, and the RA pick backs it up — worth the risk on the TBA spot.

events.title: KCSN Presents: An Evening With Goose
events.detail: Goose will be donating $1 from every ticket sold to Western Sun Foundation. Western Sun Foundation is a volunteer-run 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization that provides charitable support in the form of financial gifts to small-mid sized nonprofits in the communities fans of Goose travel through. For more information visit https://www.westernsunfoundation.org/. No portion of the ticket purchase is…
reasons: +2 editorial mention (Discover LA, Discover Los Angeles)

artist_notes.name: Goose
artist_notes.note: Connecticut jam band (formed 2014) with a devoted, Phish-adjacent live following built on lengthy improvisation — outside the usual electronic/indie lane here but a real, well-loved live act, and the Greek is a favorite room. (Note: 'jam-band' isn't yet in the subgenre vocab; flagging rather than inventing a tag.)

enrichment.curator_note: Goose isn't the usual electronic/rock lane, but they've built a genuine Phish-tier improv following, and the Greek is one of the better rooms in the city to catch that kind of show — mostly a heads-up if jam bands are your thing.
enrichment.description: Jam band Goose (KCSN Presents) at the Greek Theatre, 7pm; $1/ticket benefits Western Sun Foundation.

verdict.why: Loved room but a jam band is nowhere near this lane — the Greek bump and editorial mentions are inflating a genre that's just not on the taste map.

events.title: KAROL G - VIAJANDO POR EL MUNDO TROPITOUR
events.detail: General Public Onsale begins Wednesday, April 29, 2026 @ 10:00 AM
reasons: +2 editorial mention (Discover LA, Discover Los Angeles)

enrichment.curator_note: A stadium pop show, not the lane — this is here on Spotify-affinity signal alone, not selection or scene fit. Skip unless you're a Karol G fan going for the spectacle itself.
enrichment.description: Karol G's 'Viajando Por El Mundo Tropitour' stadium show at SoFi Stadium, 7pm.

verdict.why: Stadium reggaeton/latin-pop — off the electronic and rock lanes entirely; the editorial-mention and draw bumps are just stadium-scale noise here.

events.series_key: run:karol g viajando por el mundo tropitour|sofi stadium

events.title: Moodymann Plays Prince with DJ Rashida
events.detail: Doors: 8pm Show: 9pm 18+ Only

artist_notes.name: DJ Rashida
artist_notes.note: Rashida Gonzalez Robinson — spent a decade as Prince's touring/opening DJ and played his private parties; genuinely the person to trust with a Prince set, not a stunt booking.

enrichment.curator_note: Moodymann and someone who was actually in Prince's inner circle playing his catalog at the Regent is a real pairing, not a novelty theme night — a Detroit deep-house legend's crate plus Rashida's insider knowledge should land soulful rather than covers-band.
enrichment.description: Moodymann and DJ Rashida DJ an all-Prince set at The Regent Theater, doors 8pm, 18+.

verdict.why: DJ Rashida isn't a stunt pairing — she was Prince's actual touring DJ for a decade — and Moodymann is deep-cut royalty; an all-Prince set from these two is the rarest kind of theme night.

events.title: Al Green w/ The Womack Sisters
reasons: +2 editorial mention (Discover LA, Discover Los Angeles)

artist_notes.name: The Womack Sisters
artist_notes.note: LA soul trio (BG, Zeimani, Kucha) carrying serious family lineage — daughters of Cecil & Linda Womack, granddaughters of Sam Cooke, niece/nephews of Bobby Womack; debuting their self-titled Daptone Records album the same day as this show.

enrichment.curator_note: Al Green at the Hollywood Bowl is about as close to a guaranteed classic night as this city offers, and the Womack Sisters — Sam Cooke's granddaughters, dropping a Daptone debut that day — are a genuinely meaningful opener, not a placeholder.
enrichment.description: Soul legend Al Green headlines the Hollywood Bowl, with The Womack Sisters opening on the release day of their Daptone Records debut album.

verdict.why: Al Green doesn't tour often and the Bowl is a loved room — genuine soul legend, not a nostalgia-circuit booking, even if it's outside the electronic spine.

events.title: Post Present Medium    25 Year Anniversary Celebration, Night II…      Gun Outfi
events.detail: Post Present Medium    25 Year Anniversary Celebration, Night II…      Gun Outfit    The Spatulas ‍  ‍ (Bloomington, IN)    Chronophage ‍  ‍ (Austin, TX)    Guiding Light ‍  ‍ (Austin, TX)    Semi Trucks    Muscle Beach      Plus DJ Kate Hall!      7:30 pm    Advance $20 single day tickets available
reasons: +3 event card (+1 draw, +1 rare booking, +1 stacked bill)

artist_notes.name: Gun Outfit
artist_notes.note: Olympia-turned-LA psych/post-punk band on Post Present Medium since their 2008 debut EP — a foundational act for the label being celebrated.

artist_notes.name: The Spatulas
artist_notes.note: Bloomington, IN lo-fi punk band on the Post Present Medium roster.

artist_notes.name: Chronophage
artist_notes.note: Austin DIY punk four-piece with a sophisticated, transgressive songwriting bent — two LPs and a run of cassettes deep.

artist_notes.name: Guiding Light
artist_notes.note: Austin punk band singing bilingually in German/English over jangly, hyper-strummed garage — their debut LP just came out on Post Present Medium.

artist_notes.name: Semi Trucks
artist_notes.note: LA art-pop project fronted by Brendan Sepe, grown from a solo bedroom effort into a full band — scrappy, melodic songs.

artist_notes.name: Muscle Beach
artist_notes.note: LA four-piece delivering noisy, scattershot 'party band' improvisations — a Smell regular.

artist_notes.name: Kate Hall
artist_notes.note: No Age/Mika Miko/Dunes-adjacent LA musician (half of the News Feeds project with Luke Fischbeck & Dean Spunt) DJing the night.

enrichment.curator_note: A real DIY institution's 25th birthday at its natural home — Gun Outfit anchors a bill of scrappy touring bands (Spatulas, Chronophage, Guiding Light) that reads like a Post Present Medium family reunion, not a nostalgia cash-grab.
enrichment.description: Post Present Medium's 25th-anniversary all-ages show at The Smell: Gun Outfit, The Spatulas, Chronophage, Guiding Light, Semi Trucks, Muscle Beach, plus DJ Kate Hall, 7:30pm.

verdict.why: Gun Outfit's been on Post Present Medium since its 2008 debut — pick Friday's Night II of the label's 25th over Saturday's Night III lineup.

events.title: MARBLE x Texture Summit x Sarah Tonin: Get Milked with DJ Perception
events.genre: uk garage, uk funky, house, techno
events.organizers: Marble X Texture Summit X Sarah Tonin
events.detail: Fresh Milk brings a lineup of soulful UK garage selectors, with scene heavyweight Perception headlining this London-based label's LA debut.

artist_notes.name: DJ Perception
artist_notes.note: London (Camberwell) 2-step/UK garage specialist and MoodSwing label head, drawing on 90s US house, garage and jungle — genuine scene pedigree (RA podcast feature, Fresh Milk dubplates), not a hype booking.

artist_notes.name: Louiv
artist_notes.note: SF-based selector and founder of Texture Summit, a key Bay Area underground party/imprint since 2019 — punchy, groove-forward house and garage.

artist_notes.name: Highkin'
artist_notes.note: Moscow-born, LA-based vinyl collector and DJ — a regular in the Sunday Sessions LA rotation, active on the local underground circuit.

enrichment.curator_note: Fresh Milk is a real vinyl-only UK garage label and this is its LA debut — Perception is the kind of 2-step selector crate-diggers actually rate, not a marquee name but a legit one if a proper garage night at a mystery DTLA spot sounds fun.
enrichment.description: Fresh Milk Records' LA debut: a UK garage night at a TBA DTLA location with headliner DJ Perception, Louiv, Highkin' and Dylan Schwartz, 8pm-4am.

verdict.why: RA-pick underground slot but the headliner (DJ Perception) isn't identified in what we know — only the local support name checks out, so treat the draw as unproven.

events.title: The Odyssey (70mm)
events.detail: 70MM

enrichment.curator_note: Nolan's Odyssey printed and projected in actual 70mm at the Vista — this is the version of seeing it that's worth building an evening around instead of waiting to stream it.
enrichment.description: Christopher Nolan's big-screen adaptation of Homer's Odyssey, screening in true 70mm film at the Vista.

verdict.why: Nolan in true 70mm at the Vista on a Friday — tracked director, loved format, loved room. It's night one of only two, so this is the one to go to, not the Saturday repeat.

events.series_key: film:the odyssey

enrichment.curator_note: Dosti's a recurring disco night at Zebulon, not a one-off — a fine low-stakes plan if you're already in Frogtown on a Friday, but there's no confirmed lineup here to get excited about specifically.
enrichment.description: Dosti, a recurring disco night at Zebulon in Frogtown (Fri 8/14, 10pm).

verdict.why: Zebulon's a room you love and disco's your genre, but no lineup listed makes the actual draw a guess.

events.title: KCON LA
events.detail: Three-day Korean culture festival (Aug 14-16) with 100,000+ expected attendees, live performances, brand activations, meet-and-greets (We Like LA pick).
reasons: +2 editorial mention (We Like LA, Discover Los Angeles)

enrichment.description: Three-day Korean culture festival (Aug 14-16) at LA Convention Center with 100,000+ attendees, K-pop performances, brand activations (from $74.36/day).

verdict.why: K-pop convention/brand-activation expo, not a DJ or band booking — outside the lane no matter the crowd size.

events.title: Momma
events.detail: Visit thebellwetherla.com for everything you need to know before the show. Upgraded access to the Looking Glass Lounge is now available at check out: * Access to preferred, stage-adjacent, standing room viewing section on the balcony level in the Main Room * Access to the exclusive Looking Glass Lounge 30 minutes before and throughout the show * Looking Glass Lounge upgrades include a separate…

artist_notes.name: Momma
artist_notes.note: Brooklyn duo-fronted band (Etta Friedman, Allegra Weingarten) doing loving, well-executed 90s alt-rock/grunge revival — Polyvinyl, breakout album 'Household Name.'

artist_notes.name: Rocket
artist_notes.note: LA alt-rock band (formed 2021) with a shoegaze-leaning edge — recently opened arena dates for Smashing Pumpkins.

enrichment.curator_note: Momma's 90s-alt-revival sound (Breeders/Nirvana worship done really well) plus Rocket's shoegaze-tinged support makes for a solid rock bill if you want guitars over four-on-the-floor for a night.
enrichment.description: Brooklyn 90s-alt-revival band Momma headlines The Bellwether with LA's Rocket and Dan English opening.

verdict.why: Momma's 90s alt-rock revival is exactly the small-club indie-rock lane you want, and 'Household Name' backs up the buzz.

events.title: Iwrotehaikusaboutcannibalisminyouryearbook
events.detail: Teragram Ballroom + Your Renaissance Presents: Iwrotehaikusaboutcannibalisminyouryearbook with support from Loma Prieta, Nuvolascura, Clay Birds, Andrew DJ Set [August 14, 2026 / Doors 7pm / Show 8pm / $20 advance / $25 day of show / All Ages]
reasons: +3 event card (+1 draw, +1 rare booking, +1 stacked bill)

artist_notes.name: Iwrotehaikusaboutcannibalisminyouryearbook
artist_notes.note: Bay Area screamo band (Antioch, CA) from the mid-2000s skramz wave, broken up 2007, reactivated in 2020 — a real scene-history booking for genre diehards, outside the digest's usual electronic/rock lane.

artist_notes.name: Loma Prieta
artist_notes.note: Long-running Bay Area screamo band (since 2004) — a foundational, still-active name in the skramz revival, chaotic and dissonant.

artist_notes.name: Nuvolascura
artist_notes.note: LA screamo/mathcore four-piece (formerly Vril) blending skramz with technical, dissonant hardcore — one of the genre's current top-tier acts.

artist_notes.name: Clay Birds
artist_notes.note: Couldn't confidently verify which band this billing refers to (conflicting bios online) — leaving uncharacterized rather than guessing.

enrichment.curator_note: This is proper skramz-scene history at Teragram — iwrotehaikusaboutcannibalisminyouryearbook reactivated after a decade off, next to genre stalwarts Loma Prieta and Nuvolascura; heavier and more chaotic than most of what's on the list, but a real one if hardcore/screamo is in your world.
enrichment.description: Screamo/hardcore bill at Teragram Ballroom: iwrotehaikusaboutcannibalisminyouryearbook, Loma Prieta, Nuvolascura, Clay Birds, doors 7pm.

verdict.why: This is a screamo/skramz bill, not the post-punk/dream-pop indie lane — great for the genre's diehards, wrong flavor of loud for you.

events.title: Brenna Whitaker Little Big Band – Vintage Jazz & Soulful Vocals
events.detail: Brenna Whitaker brings her stunning voice and deep storytelling to a night of vintage jazz and soul  Shows: 7pm & 9:30pm   Reserve Now

enrichment.description: Vintage jazz and soul with vocalist Brenna Whitaker at Vibrato Grill Jazz in Bel Air.

verdict.why: Vintage jazz vocals in Bel Air — the 'vinyl/groove' bump in the score is a mis-hit since there's no DJ set here, and jazz sits outside your actual lanes.

events.title: Tropical Showcase w/ Colette, Ben Annand, DJ Dazy, Bird Lady
events.venue: TBA - Deep End Live - Redondo Beach

artist_notes.name: Colette
artist_notes.note: Chicago-bred, LA-based house DJ/producer/vocalist — signed to Nettwerk in the early 2000s, four albums since 2005 ('When The Music's Loud' made Vice's 99 greatest dance albums list); tuneful, vocal-forward underground house.

artist_notes.name: Ben Annand
artist_notes.note: LA electronic scene fixture since the mid-'90s — longtime resident at Moontribe and founder of the Tropical party series (boats, warehouses, the desert); Balearic/tribal-leaning outdoor-party lane.

enrichment.curator_note: Colette's a real one — Chicago underground roots, a Nettwerk deal, two decades of vocal house records — so this is worth the TBA-location gamble even without an afterhours build to lean on.
enrichment.description: A tech-house/deep-house showcase at a TBA Redondo Beach-area location, headlined by veteran house DJ-producer Colette with Ben Annand, DJ Dazy and Bird Lady.

verdict.why: Colette's disco/italo-leaning vocal-house is genuinely on-brand for the groove boost, but Redondo Beach is a real trek for a Wednesday.

artist_notes.name: The Stitches
artist_notes.note: OC garage-punk institution since 1994 — snotty, high-energy '70s-style punk in the Rip Off Records/Dirtnap lane, one of the scene's most volatile, fun live acts.

enrichment.curator_note: RA had this filed under electronic — it's actually an OC punk institution, a snotty, fast, unpredictable live band, not a DJ set. Worth the fix.
enrichment.description: OC garage-punk veterans The Stitches at The Redwood Bar, 8pm.

verdict.why: OC garage-punk vets in the Dirtnap/Rip Off lane — exactly the snotty small-room rock this taste rewards, underrated at a plain 6.

events.title: MUZIQUE Fridays @ Kiss Kiss Bang Bang w/ SWOOPS + Special Guest DJS
events.detail: FRIDAY NIGHT DANCE PARTY! **FREE ALL NIGHT w/ RSVP**

enrichment.description: Free Friday night dance party with SWOOPS at Kiss Kiss Bang Bang.

verdict.why: Free house/disco Friday, but 'special guest DJs' with no names attached is too thin to call beyond a maybe.

events.title: The Dark Knight Rises

enrichment.curator_note: No format called out here, so presumably a standard print rather than the 70mm treatment — still a fun midnight rewatch of Nolan's Batman trilogy closer at a venue built for exactly this kind of late show.
enrichment.description: Late-night (11pm) screening of Christopher Nolan's 2012 The Dark Knight Rises at the Vista Theater.

artist_notes.name: Abe Vigoda
artist_notes.note: LA experimental/'tropical punk' band from the mid-2000s Smell scene, on Post Present Medium — jittery, humid, post-punk-meets-tropicalia; this run is a reunion set for the label's anniversary.

artist_notes.name: Callahan & Witscher
artist_notes.note: NYC duo of two veteran underground experimentalists (Jack Callahan, aka die Reihe; Jeff Witscher, aka Rene Hell) whose new project is a surprising, hooky pivot toward songs after years of noise/ambient work.

artist_notes.name: Debt Rag
artist_notes.note: Olympia, WA punk trio (former members of Grass Widow and Girlsperm) playing guitarless, clattering, drum-and-keyboard punk — Post Present Medium's 2023 LP 'Lost to the Fantasy.'

artist_notes.name: The Intima
artist_notes.note: Portland post-punk quartet, violin-driven, active 1999-2004 and recently reunited — shared stages with The Rapture and The Mekons back in the day; PPM reissued their 'Peril and Panic' LP.

enrichment.curator_note: Three nights deep into Post Present Medium's 25th-anniversary run and this one's genuinely stacked — Abe Vigoda's tropical-punk reunion, Callahan & Witscher's weird new pivot into actual songs, and DIY lifers Debt Rag and reunited Portland post-punk act The Intima. This is the Smell's classic guitars-and-noise lane, not the club side of things.
enrichment.description: Night three of The Smell's Post Present Medium 25th-anniversary celebration: reunited LA tropical-punk band Abe Vigoda, experimental duo Callahan & Witscher, Olympia's Debt Rag, and reunited Portland post-punk band The Intima.

events.title: Mezzanine: Rob Tregenza's Talking to Strangers (1988)

artist_notes.name: Rob Tregenza
artist_notes.note: American structuralist filmmaker — Talking to Strangers (1988) is his triple-threat debut (writer/director/cinematographer): nine unbroken 10-minute 35mm takes, shot once each, sequenced by computer-randomized order. The NYT called it an antidote to jazzy montage; a genuine formalist curio, not a normal narrative feature.

enrichment.curator_note: This is about as structurally radical as rep programming gets — nine single-take, ten-minute 35mm shots, filmed once apiece, no coverage. Not a comfortable watch, but exactly the kind of print/format-driven booking the Mezzanine series exists for.
enrichment.description: 2220 Arts + Archives' Mezzanine series screens Rob Tregenza's Talking to Strangers (1988), a formally radical nine-take 35mm feature.

verdict.why: Formalist 35mm curio at the loved 2220 room — niche draw but exactly the print-driven cinephile booking this taste wants.

events.title: INCOGNITO and Dirty Epic present: Further with DJ Bone, Stacey Hotwaxx Hale & Mapamota
events.detail: Two Detroit legends come to LA for a serious affair of pounding techno, electro and slamming house music. (Disclaimer: An RA staffer is involved with this event.)

artist_notes.name: DJ Bone
artist_notes.note: Detroit techno lifer (Eric Dulan), founder of Subject Detroit — deep, hypnotic, no-filler techno from someone who's been doing it since the '90s underground scene.

artist_notes.name: Stacey Hotwaxx Hale
artist_notes.note: Detroit house pioneer often called the 'Godmother of House' — spinning since the late '70s/'80s at clubs like Chessmate and Todd's, one of the first women behind the decks in the genre's birthplace.

artist_notes.name: Mapamota
artist_notes.note: LA DJ and event producer (behind Direct Drive, Serenity Link, Soul Swap) — house, afrobeats, techno and global club rhythms, built around percussive, high-energy sets.

enrichment.curator_note: A TBA-location afterhours booking with real lineage for once — DJ Bone and Stacey Hotwaxx Hale are actual Detroit techno/house pioneers, not just another anonymous warehouse bill.
enrichment.description: INCOGNITO and Dirty Epic present an 11pm afterhours set with Detroit techno/house pioneers DJ Bone and Stacey Hotwaxx Hale alongside Mapamota, location TBA.

verdict.why: DJ Bone and Stacey Hotwaxx Hale are actual Detroit techno/house pioneers, not tribute names — a genuine deep-selector afterhours the score's flattening a bit.

artist_notes.name: Rimarkable
artist_notes.note: Detroit-rooted, LA-based house/techno DJ-producer and longtime host of the Defected Radio Show — soul/funk/disco-inflected sets, decks shared with Louie Vega and Honey Dijon.

artist_notes.name: Juliet Mendoza
artist_notes.note: 25-year LA house scene veteran, founder of Jill's House (Jackin' Jills) and a 2022 Defected Unsung Hero — dancer-rooted, deep and soulful selections.

enrichment.curator_note: Two real LA house-scene lifers with genuine Defected pedigree at a Lincoln Heights bar — low-key room, high-pedigree booking.
enrichment.description: Club night at The Airliner (Lincoln Heights) with house DJs Rimarkable and Juliet Mendoza, both with Defected Records ties.

verdict.why: Juliet Mendoza's in your strong rotation and this is her home turf — soulful Defected-orbit house in a small Lincoln Heights bar, exactly the sleeper the score underweights.

events.title: SET & Safra with MONKEY SAFARI & MARQUES WYATT Under the 6th St Bridge, LA
events.detail: Six hours of deep house, open air under the 6th Street Bridge. Monkey Safari and Marques Wyatt in Los Angeles. Friday, August 21.

artist_notes.name: Monkey Safari
artist_notes.note: German duo (Get Physical, Anjunadeep, Bedrock) making sunny, melodic organic house — run their own Hommage label and own a club in their hometown of Halle.

artist_notes.name: Marques Wyatt
artist_notes.note: West Coast deep house legend — ran LA's long-running Deep party/residency from the late '90s into the 2010s and is generally credited with helping put LA's dance scene on the map alongside NYC and Miami.

enrichment.curator_note: Marques Wyatt basically built the LA deep house scene from the ground up, and pairing him with Monkey Safari's sunnier melodic sound for six hours under the bridge is a genuinely thoughtful booking, not just a location flex.
enrichment.description: Six-hour open-air deep house party under the 6th Street Bridge with Monkey Safari and LA scene veteran Marques Wyatt.

verdict.why: Marques Wyatt basically built LA's deep house scene, and six hours open-air under the bridge with Monkey Safari is a real groove night — the 9pm-3am framing reads underground, not the 'day party' the tag suggests.

events.title: Matthew Dear B2B The Juan MacLean, Mesme

artist_notes.name: Matthew Dear
artist_notes.note: Ghostly International's flagship artist since the early 2000s (also records minimal techno as Audion) — moody, baritone-vocal art-pop laid over deep, European-club-respected production; a real crossover between listening-room songwriting and functional techno.

artist_notes.name: The Juan MacLean
artist_notes.note: John MacLean's long-running DFA Records project (James Murphy's label, home of LCD Soundsystem) — NYC dance-punk-turned-disco, best known for 'Happy House'; DJ sets lean house and post-punk-inflected disco.

artist_notes.name: Mesme
artist_notes.note: LA-based (via the Midwest and Singapore) DJ and Into the Woods resident with a monthly dublab show — vinyl-heavy sets blending house, techno, acid, electro and trip-hop; a 2021 Boiler Room appearance and a 2020 EP on Steel City Dance Discs.

enrichment.curator_note: Matthew Dear and The Juan MacLean b2b is a properly odd pairing — Ghostly's moody minimal-techno lineage next to DFA's dance-punk-turned-disco lineage — and Lodge Room is the right-sized room to hear it actually take shape.
enrichment.description: Ghostly International's Matthew Dear b2b DFA's The Juan MacLean, with Mesme opening, at Lodge Room (Fri 8/21, 8pm, $26).

verdict.why: Matthew Dear b2b The Juan MacLean is a genuine Ghostly-meets-DFA pairing at a venue you already love for $26 — great value, just not quite marquee-headliner scale.

artist_notes.note: LA-based Russian DJ/producer working trippy, deep, off-beat and minimal-leaning electronic sounds with a progressive touch — an established name on the local underground techno circuit.

artist_notes.name: Afriqua
artist_notes.note: Adam Longman Parker — Virginia-born, Berlin-based producer on R&S Records; his 2019 LP 'Colored' fused deep house/techno with an explicit Black-culture lens. A genuinely respected, thoughtful name — arguably the most substantive booking on this bill.

artist_notes.name: Azzecca
artist_notes.note: Chicago DJ/producer (Allie DeCastris) and COSIMEA label boss — cosmic, dark, disco-inflected house/techno; a Beatport 'Next Artist' for 2025 who's shared bills with Tale of Us and CamelPhat.

artist_notes.name: Ray Kash
artist_notes.note: LA underground fixture since 2010 (Temple Tuesdays resident) — deep house into techno and melodic, weaned on Danny Tenaglia/Jonathan Peters-style New York house.

enrichment.curator_note: Afriqua alone is worth the trip to DTLA — R&S-signed, one of the more substantive deep house/techno voices around — and Azzecca/Ray Kash round it into a real groove-forward bill rather than another generic warehouse night.

verdict.why: Anjunadeep's Durante on a DTLA rooftop pool party is squarely the melodic/organic house lane you track, in broad daylight no less.

events.title: KCRW presents Latroit House Ensemble with Jason Bentley

artist_notes.name: Latroit
artist_notes.note: Dennis White — Detroit-rooted, LA-based house producer since the late '80s; won a 2018 Grammy for Best Remixed Recording on his Depeche Mode 'You Move' remix and runs the House of Latroit label/podcast.

artist_notes.name: Jason Bentley
artist_notes.note: KCRW's longtime music director and Metropolis host — a tastemaker DJ who's shaped the station's house/downtempo/global sound for decades.

enrichment.curator_note: Latroit's got real house pedigree — Detroit roots, a Grammy for that Depeche Mode remix — so pairing him with Jason Bentley's KCRW ear reads like a legit live-house-band show, not a DJ-booth filler slot.
enrichment.description: KCRW's Jason Bentley joins Grammy-winning house producer Latroit's live ensemble at Say Yes.

verdict.why: A Grammy-winning Detroit house vet fronting a live ensemble with KCRW's Jason Bentley is a genuinely unusual booking, not a standard club-night DJ set.

artist_notes.name: Secondcity
artist_notes.note: UK house producer behind 2014's global hit 'I Wanna Feel' and a Grammy-nominated remixer (Fall Out Boy's 'Centuries') — polished, vocal-driven house that's toured festival mainstages for a decade; he and Noizu have a track together ('More Love'), so this pairing tracks.

artist_notes.name: Noizu
artist_notes.note: UK-born, now LA-based tech-house producer (real name Jacob Plant) — runs his own label TECHNE Records, broke through via Chris Lake/Skrillex's HOWSLA and the platinum single 'Summer 91.' Crowd-pleasing but well-crafted house/tech-house, the mainstream end of the lane this taste explicitly wants.

enrichment.curator_note: Noizu and Secondcity already have a track together, so this reads less like a random support slot and more like two guys who genuinely like playing back to back — polished, danceable tech-house that doesn't need underground credibility to sell it.
enrichment.description: Tech-house night headlined by Noizu with Secondcity and Galo at Shrine Auditorium and Expo Hall (Sat 8/22, 9pm).

verdict.why: Noizu is exactly the mainstream tech-house lane this brief says counts, and Secondcity has real production pedigree (they've got a track together) so it's more than a paycheck booking.

artist_notes.name: Sonrisita
artist_notes.note: LA DJ and record collector (Melissa Dueñas) — boogie, disco and soul selections that range into spiritual jazz and lovers rock; has opened for Dam-Funk and Quantic. Straight down the groove/disco-leaning lane.

artist_notes.name: Andy Oro
artist_notes.note: LA DJ, host of the Oro Hour on VPN Radio and a Made to Move resident — eclectic underground/house sets pulling from DIY dance music, hip-hop and bloghouse.

artist_notes.name: Akumen
artist_notes.note: LA DJ who's shared bills with Andy Oro (a recent Kremwerk co-headline in Seattle) — thin public track record beyond that, so treat as an unknown quantity.

enrichment.curator_note: Sonrisita's boogie-and-disco crate is the real reason to go — a dublab x VPN Radio crossover (two of LA's actual underground radio institutions) at an unpretentious Lincoln Heights dive bar, not a polished club booking.
enrichment.description: dublab's RADIO4RADIO series pairs the freeform station with VPN Radio for a night of underground selectors — Sonrisita, Akumen, Andy Oro, maxim_ESL and Guaparda — at The Airliner in Lincoln Heights.

verdict.why: Sonrisita's boogie/disco/soul digging is exactly the groove-leaning lane you gravitate to, and dublab's freeform pedigree plus a small eastside bar make this the sleeper of the batch.

artist_notes.name: Chris Cruse
artist_notes.note: LA warehouse-scene DJ since 2001 and founder of Spotlight, the long-running queer-rooted house/techno/disco party — now Berlin-based, plays Panorama Bar and the festival circuit; a tough, sleazy, soulful sound.

artist_notes.name: Juliet Mendoza
artist_notes.note: 25-year LA house scene veteran, founder of Jill's House (Jackin' Jills) and a 2022 Defected Unsung Hero — dancer-rooted, deep and soulful selections.

artist_notes.name: Soul Purpose (LA)
artist_notes.note: LA underground/festival selector (Splash House, Lightning in a Bottle, EDC) blending disco, 90s house, minimal, techno and hard groove — a dancefloor generalist more than a specialist.

enrichment.curator_note: Chris Cruse doesn't play LA much these days now that he's based in Berlin, so a new series pulling him back for a District 7 debut next to Juliet Mendoza's Defected-pedigree deep house is worth watching, even with the room itself still an unknown quantity.
enrichment.description: New CATEGORY series debut ('Precious Metals') at District 7 with LA house/techno DJ Chris Cruse, Juliet Mendoza and Soul Purpose, Sat 8/22, 10pm.

verdict.why: Juliet Mendoza is real deep/soulful house pedigree (Jill's House, Defected Unsung Heroes) that lines up with your groove lane better than the score's mid-tier number suggests.

events.title: Just Like Heaven Festival
lineup: The Strokes LCD Soundsystem Dayglow Whitney  Porches STRFKR TV Girl Chromeo The Rapture Feist Twin Peaks George Clanton Coco & Clair Clair EKKSTACY Matt and Kim Pixel Grip This is Lorelei Tanlines Girl Tones Them Jeans A Club Called Rhonda

artist_notes.name: A Club Called Rhonda
artist_notes.note: LA's own queer disco/house institution (Loren Granic & Gregory Alexander) — the closest thing on this bill to the rooftop-groove lane, all disco edits and drag-flecked chaos rather than a band.

enrichment.curator_note: The Strokes and LCD Soundsystem headlining a Rose Bowl day is worth it even at arena scale — the undercard (Chromeo, Feist, A Club Called Rhonda) leans danceable rather than pure nostalgia-bait.
enrichment.description: Indie/dance-punk day festival at Brookside at the Rose Bowl headlined by The Strokes and LCD Soundsystem, with Chromeo, Feist, Twin Peaks, Dayglow and a long support bill.

verdict.why: Strokes/LCD/Chromeo day festival is a genuinely stacked bill, just running indie-rock rather than house — A Club Called Rhonda's disco set is the one hour that's actually your lane.

artist_notes.name: Oguz
artist_notes.note: Dutch-Turkish techno DJ/producer — high-tempo, hard-driving peak-time techno, a regular on the international festival/club circuit. Refined-end-of-techno rather than melodic.

enrichment.curator_note: Straight peak-time techno at Exchange LA's Mutate series — no groove or daytime softness here, this is a full-tempo club night for when that's the mood.
enrichment.description: Mutate techno night at Exchange LA featuring Dutch-Turkish techno DJ Oguz.

verdict.why: Oguz plays the same hard-driving lane as Charlotte de Witte and Amelie Lens, both artists you track, and techno's your top Spotify genre — worth more than a plain 7.

events.genre: drum and bass, jungle, jump up
events.detail: This new LA party brings two in-demand drum & bass artists from the UK for a night of deep rollers and high-energy action.

enrichment.description: I Love Dnb: drum-and-bass and jungle night with Voltage, AC13, Dr. Apollo and more (10pm–4am, $20–25, TBA).

artist_notes.name: Boris
artist_notes.note: Longtime Berlin techno figure — SWXCH bills him as a Berghain/Panorama Bar resident, and this is his ongoing residency there (volume 7 now); decades of stripped-back, hypnotic techno for queer dancefloors. (Note: there's more than one touring 'Boris' — this bio follows SWXCH's own description of their resident.)

artist_notes.name: John Bryars
artist_notes.note: LA local, eclectic acid/techno/electro/EBM selector who's played A Club Called Rhonda and Boiler Room — a good bet for a genuinely varied warm-up set.

artist_notes.name: Kittamami
artist_notes.note: Detroit-bred, LA-based DJ/producer blending house and techno with empowering vocal-driven tracks; active across the local warehouse scene.

enrichment.curator_note: Boris's ongoing Berghain-style residency is patient, stripped-back techno rather than a flashy headline booking — John Bryars' genuinely eclectic warm-up might be the better reason to show up on time.
enrichment.description: SWXCH's queer techno night (vol. 7) with resident Boris, John Bryars and Kittamami at a TBA warehouse (Sat 8/22, 10pm-5am, $20 before 11pm).

verdict.why: Warehouse techno with a Berghain-resident-billed headliner (per the promoter's own bio, some ambiguity there) plus a deep local support bill.

events.title: SOUNDWAVE & GREAT QUALITY ENTERTAINMNET PRESENT: Oliver Koletzki

artist_notes.name: Oliver Koletzki
artist_notes.note: Hamburg-via-Berlin producer, founder of Stil vor Talent (20 years running) — his 2005 track 'Der Mückenschwarm' on Sven Väth's Cocoon helped define the melodic-house wave that came after. Big, emotive, festival-ready; closer to Dixon/Adriatique than deep underground.

enrichment.curator_note: Koletzki's been doing the big-room-but-emotive melodic house thing since before it was a genre label — a solid, reliable pick if you want groove without going full techno.
enrichment.description: Melodic house/techno set from Stil vor Talent founder Oliver Koletzki at Berlin (the LA club).

verdict.why: Koletzki founded Stil vor Talent and sounds like Dixon and Adriatique, both squarely in your melodic-house wheelhouse — Berlin's a real club, not a bottle-service room.

events.title: An Evening with Charlize Theron Featuring Mad Max: Fury Road
events.detail: An Evening with Charlize Theron: conversation followed by a screening of Mad Max: Fury Road (2015, DCP).

enrichment.curator_note: Fury Road holds up as one of the best pure-action films of the last 20 years no matter the format, and Theron talking Furiosa before it rolls is the actual reason to show up.
enrichment.description: Charlize Theron in conversation, followed by a screening of Mad Max: Fury Road (2015, DCP) at the Academy Museum.

verdict.why: In-person Charlize Theron conversation plus Fury Road at the Academy — the rare-draw, rare-booking combo the card metrics are flagging, and you already reacted to this one.

enrichment.curator_note: Don't let the 'Rush Hour' in the title fool you — this is SPICE's own global-club night (amapiano, reggaeton, Bollywood, dancehall), not the Amsterdam house label; fun if that's the mood tonight, but it's a different lane than the house/techno stuff.
enrichment.description: SPICE — the DJ crew/label of Aku, Bianca Maieli, DJ SUDI and MTooray — plays a global-club night blending amapiano, reggaeton, Bollywood, dancehall and Baile Funk at The Melrose House.

events.title: Panic Room feat. Shane Thomas, Rob Aquino, Banoffee & Geoboi

artist_notes.name: Shane Thomas
artist_notes.note: LA producer/DJ, Ace Hotel-residency host of the party blush! — experimental house and techno spliced with reggaeton, dancehall and ballroom edits.

artist_notes.name: Rob Aquino
artist_notes.note: Silver Lake-based promoter (co-runs the monthly Loose party with Bebe) — a fixture of LA's queer underground, mixing techno, house and pop into something weirder than a straight dance set.

artist_notes.name: Banoffee
artist_notes.note: Melbourne-born, LA-based alt-pop producer/singer (Martha Brown) — SOPHIE collaborator and Charli XCX/Empress Of/King Princess associate with deep roots in the queer club circuit; more pop-production pedigree than a straight DJ.

artist_notes.name: Geoboi
artist_notes.note: LA DJ with a thin public bio but a real footprint on the Echo Park/queer-underground circuit (played Sorbet at TBA - Echo Park alongside Shane Thomas) — a dancefloor-first selector.

enrichment.curator_note: Rob Aquino and Shane Thomas both come out of LA's queer-underground crate-digging side, so expect this TBA-location afterhours to run stranger and looser than a standard tech-house night — nobody on the bill is a huge name, but that's kind of the point.
enrichment.description: TBA-location Silver Lake afterhours party (starts midnight) with Shane Thomas, Rob Aquino, Banoffee and Geoboi.

verdict.why: Shane Thomas (blush!) and Rob Aquino (Loose) are real Silver Lake queer-underground fixtures, not a random TBA booking — the afterhours-in-your-backyard pattern you're primed for.

events.title: Haddaway, Ultra Naté, Robin S, Crystal Waters & More
reasons: +4 event card (+3 draw, +1 rare booking, +1 stacked bill)

artist_notes.name: Ultra Naté
artist_notes.note: Baltimore club/house vocalist behind '90s anthem 'Free' — a real voice of that Yoshitoshi/Deep Dish-adjacent house era, not a manufactured pop act.

artist_notes.name: Crystal Waters
artist_notes.note: NYC deep-house vocalist — 'Gypsy Woman (She's Homeless)' and '100% Pure Love,' both Basement Boys productions, are genuine foundational house-anthem catalog.

artist_notes.name: Robin S
artist_notes.note: UK house vocalist whose 'Show Me Love' (1993) is one of the most sampled/replayed piano-house records ever — a real genre landmark even if the name itself isn't a household one.

enrichment.curator_note: This is a house-legends day party, not a tribute act — Haddaway, Ultra Naté, Robin S and Crystal Waters all made the actual records, so a free outdoor DTLA stage is a genuinely good way to hear 'Show Me Love' and 'Gypsy Woman' from the people who made them.
enrichment.description: Outdoor '90s house-classics day party at Pershing Square with original vocalists Haddaway, Ultra Naté, Robin S and Crystal Waters.

verdict.why: Ultra Naté, Crystal Waters and Robin S are the actual voices behind foundational house anthems, not a tribute act singing over tracks — a free outdoor party built on real genre history.

events.title: WHATEVER UNDERGROUND
reasons: +2 more like Things You Say (your pick)

sounds_like: Shane Thomas's blush! parties (techno x reggaeton/ballroom edits)

artist_notes.name: Shane Thomas
artist_notes.note: LA DJ/producer and host of the recurring blush! party — blends experimental techno with reggaeton, dancehall, ballroom and classic rave cuts rather than playing it straight techno.

artist_notes.name: Things You Say
artist_notes.note: LA house DJ/producer ('say less and dance more') out of the city's club scene — a name already flagged in your own reactions.

artist_notes.name: KNOXDOTMP3
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ/producer (KNOX) working house, ballroom and club sounds — released mix series like 'Club Cowboy' and played the VICE Underground 'Cage' night.

artist_notes.name: Flabbergast (LA)
artist_notes.note: LA techno DJ (Miami-raised, DIY rave background) and founder of VICE Underground — heavy drums, acid-driven, high-energy sets built for a transformative dancefloor, not a chill room.

artist_notes.name: BUCK/OFF
artist_notes.note: LA DJ who's played Catch One, Los Globos and Avalon — moves from Chicago-style house by day to tech-house after dark; co-founded the Reverb party brand.

enrichment.curator_note: Eight deep on a location-TBA afterhours bill, and more of it checks out than usual for this kind of listing — Shane Thomas and Flabbergast (LA) are real working names in LA's underground techno/DIY scene, though ZAVODA, Nic Jericho and masato don't turn up a verifiable track record anywhere.
enrichment.description: Location-TBA afterhours techno party with eight LA DJs/producers, including Shane Thomas, Things You Say, KNOXDOTMP3, Flabbergast (LA) and BUCK/OFF.

verdict.why: Deep 8-DJ techno/house/acid bill (Shane Thomas's blush!, Flabbergast's VICE Underground) is legit, but the Spotify-matched name here, Things You Say, is a low-profile local project per the scene notes so don't overweight that signal.

events.title: Studio Barnhus Summer Dance Party with Axel Boman, Kornel Kovacs, Nikki Nair
reasons: +4 event card (+2 draw, +1 rare booking, +1 stacked bill)

artist_notes.name: Axel Boman
artist_notes.note: Swedish producer and Studio Barnhus co-founder — playful, eclectic deep house with a loose, jammy feel (his 'Purple Drank' and marathon festival sets are genre-defining); this is basically his label's home-turf party.

artist_notes.name: Kornél Kovács
artist_notes.note: Studio Barnhus co-founder alongside Axel Boman — bright, melodic, disco-tinged house; one of the most purely fun-first DJs in the European house scene.

artist_notes.name: Nikki Nair
artist_notes.note: Atlanta producer/DJ blending techno, electro, breaks and UK bass into something genre-agnostic and physical — releases on Dirtybird and Lobster Theremin, mentored early by Underground Resistance's Mike Banks.

artist_notes.name: Masha Mar
artist_notes.note: Serbian-born, LA-based selector who co-founded Dig Deeper LA and co-runs Take It Outside — cosmic disco, deep house and left-field selections.

artist_notes.name: Tottie
artist_notes.note: Dublab-affiliated LA radio host and co-founder of SOS Music, a !K7-backed label/platform spotlighting women and non-binary electronic artists.

artist_notes.name: Stacy Christine
artist_notes.note: LA warehouse-scene DJ since 2012 (Music For Dancers, Critter Control, Machine Club lineage) — joyful house into kinetic techno; has opened for DJ Harvey, Moodymann, and Honey Dijon.

enrichment.curator_note: Both Studio Barnhus co-founders in one room for an outdoor day party is the label doing exactly what it does best — warm, playful house that doesn't take itself too seriously. Nikki Nair going way outside that lane only makes the bill more interesting.
enrichment.description: Studio Barnhus label showcase at The Bridge, DTLA, with co-founders Axel Boman and Kornél Kovács plus Nikki Nair, Masha Mar, Tottie and Stacy Christine (Sat 9/5, 5pm).

verdict.why: Boman and Kovács are basically throwing their own label's home party outdoors in DTLA, and Masha Mar — someone you're deep in rotation on — is on the same bill. Build the Saturday around this.

events.title: Certified Groovers: DJ Sneak [All night - Vinyl Set]

artist_notes.name: DJ Sneak
artist_notes.note: Chicago house OG ('the Turntable Terrorist') — jacking, sample-heavy garage-house going back to the early-'90s Cajmere/Relief era, still DJing at that level today.

enrichment.curator_note: DJ Sneak going all night on vinyl only is the kind of booking that makes a TBA text worth waiting for — Chicago jacking house from one of its actual architects, not a nostalgia lap.
enrichment.description: DJ Sneak plays an all-night, vinyl-only set at a TBA Downtown LA location (Sat 9/5, 10pm).

verdict.why: DJ Sneak vinyl-only all night at a TBA DTLA warehouse is peak-lane material — a real Chicago OG, just a solo bill with no support so it sits a notch under the label showcases on the slate.

events.title: DJ Susan POOL PARTY at Level 8 [Labor Day Saturday]
events.detail: Celebrate Labor Day Weekend with DJ Susan...Poolside!

artist_notes.name: DJ Susan
artist_notes.note: Alias of Steven Glathe (Hood Politics Records, San Diego) — bass/tech-house built for big builds and gritty drops, several Beatport #1s. More festival-EDM energy than a groove selector.

enrichment.curator_note: Labor Day rooftop pool party checks the setting boxes (near home, Saturday, open-air), but DJ Susan is a build-and-drop bass-house guy, not a digger — go for the pool and the day-drinking, not a deep set.
enrichment.description: Labor Day Saturday daytime pool party (2-8pm) at Level 8's rooftop deck headlined by bass/tech-house DJ Susan.

verdict.why: DJ Susan's bass/tech-house is built for big drops over groove — closer to festival-EDM than the deep/soulful lane you actually chase, even with the pool deck.

events.title: Penniback Presents: Summer Mass with Wavves, Modern Color, and MORE
events.detail: Wavves Modern Color Waax Beach Bums The Paranoyds Sludge Mother BRAYTON Never Easy fera MICA Street Play Pop free Roving THIS IS AN ALL AGES EVENT The Belasco is a STANDING ROOM ONLY venue. We have a dedicated area for guests in wheelchairs and their companions, which is available on a first-come, first-served basis. Please contact us at THEBELASCO@LIVENATION.COM or (213) 531-0580 for questions…

artist_notes.name: Wavves
artist_notes.note: Nathan Williams' surf-punk/lo-fi indie project out of San Diego — bratty, noise-caked guitar pop since 2008's 'Wavvves'; a real touring name with an actual catalog, not a local opener.

artist_notes.name: Waax
artist_notes.note: Brisbane, Australia post-punk/garage band fronted by Marie 'Maz' DeVita — raw, emotive, three albums deep (most recently 2026's 'Angel's Mess').

artist_notes.name: The Paranoyds
artist_notes.note: LA garage-rock/indie-punk four-piece out of the local DIY scene — Bratmobile-meets-Go-Go's energy, Third Man-affiliated, played Coachella and opened for Jack White.

artist_notes.name: Modern Color
artist_notes.note: Redondo Beach four-piece that started as metalcore and evolved into 'grungegaze' — alt-rock with shoegaze/hardcore edges, in the Hum/Title Fight/Deftones lineage.

enrichment.curator_note: Reads more like a surf-punk/garage day festival than a straight headline show — Wavves still has the songs, but Waax and The Paranoyds are strong enough on their own that it's worth showing up early instead of just catching the top of the bill.
enrichment.description: Wavves headline an all-ages day bill at The Belasco with Modern Color, Waax, Beach Bums, The Paranoyds and Sludge Mother.

verdict.why: Wavves headlining a day-party indie/garage bill at The Belasco — real draw, fits the small-band garage-pop lane even scaled up to a hall.

events.title: Korolova
events.detail: Techno DJ Korolova headlines a late-night set.

artist_notes.name: Korolova
artist_notes.note: Olga Korolova — Ukrainian melodic-techno/progressive-house producer, ex-ballet dancer turned DJ; runs the Captive Soul label/radio show, plays Tomorrowland mainstage and EDC, DJ Mag top-60 (2024).

enrichment.curator_note: She's a legit DJ Mag top-60 name working the Anjunabeats/Tomorrowland melodic-techno lane — not underground-digger territory, but a genuinely festival-caliber headliner landing in a club-sized room for once.
enrichment.description: Ukrainian melodic-techno/progressive-house DJ Korolova headlines a late-night set at Avalon Hollywood.

verdict.why: Korolova's a real techno name with Boiler Room heat behind her — Avalon's mainstream but the booking's on-genre and worth the trip to Hollywood.

events.title: Deep House Brunch POOL PARTY [Labor Day Saturday]
events.venue: White Rabbit Sky Lounge at The Valorian (Formerly Skybar at Mondrian)
events.detail: Deep House Brunch Pool Party Returns!

artist_notes.name: Scotty Boy
artist_notes.note: Vegas-based house veteran (25+ years, three Billboard Dance #1s) and founder of DTLA's long-running 'Deep House Brunch' — plays crowd-friendly deep/jackin' house and nu-disco edits, more festival-polish than underground digger.

enrichment.curator_note: Scotty Boy plays it crowd-pleasing and polished rather than deep-digger, but that iconic Skybar pool deck at golden hour is doing most of the work here anyway.
enrichment.description: Scotty Boy's long-running Deep House Brunch pool party lands on Labor Day Saturday at White Rabbit Sky Lounge — the rooftop pool deck formerly known as Skybar at the Mondrian.

verdict.why: Labor Day pool-party deep house with a festival-polish veteran — exactly the daytime rooftop-adjacent groove this taste rewards, even if Scotty Boy plays crowd-pleaser over digger sets.

artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ (dublab resident, 'Hearing Color') and founder of the queer underground party Planet Love — deep house, dreamy techno, Italo, Balearic and psych-disco; a real musician's ear (former pianist), has played alongside Octo Octa, Eris Drew, Derrick Carter.

artist_notes.name: Masha Mar
artist_notes.note: Serbian-born, LA-based DJ/curator (the Midnight Lovers crew) with NTS and Dublab residencies — Italo disco, house and dancefloor edits.

enrichment.curator_note: Massimiliano Pagliara headlining Midnight Lovers is a legitimate European-club booking — Berghain-lineage electro-disco with Masha Mar and James Axon rounding it out with LA's own deep-house/dublab crowd. This is the kind of night the fabric-London comparison is actually built for.
enrichment.description: Midnight Lovers presents Berlin's Massimiliano Pagliara at The Bridge, DTLA, with Masha Mar and James Axon, 9pm.

verdict.why: Masha Mar is a core Spotify artist for you and Pagliara's got real Berghain Basement pedigree — European disco-house at a room you can actually plan around, not a TBA gamble.

events.title: Âme, DJ Tennis, Kaz James - Chinatown Block Party
reasons: +4 event card (+2 draw, +1 rare booking, +1 stacked bill)

sounds_like: Life and Death's soulful, post-rock-tinged house

artist_notes.name: DJ Tennis
artist_notes.note: Manfredi Romano — Italian scene godfather who founded Life and Death in 2010 (Tale Of Us, Mind Against and Carlita all came up through the label); a globally touring, melodic house/techno selector with real ties to the Innervisions crowd via the Rakastella festival.

artist_notes.name: Kaz James
artist_notes.note: Australian DJ/producer with old-school pedigree — a decade-long Pacha Ibiza residency (Nic Fanciulli's 'We Are The Night') behind him, now making straight-up house that's charted with tracks like 'Not in Love' and 'Footprints.'

artist_notes.name: Masha Mar
artist_notes.note: Serbian-born, LA-based DJ/curator (the Midnight Lovers crew) with NTS and Dublab residencies — Italo disco, house and dancefloor edits.

enrichment.curator_note: Âme running an actual outdoor Chinatown block party — not a warehouse pop-up or a festival stage — is exactly the kind of booking worth clearing a Saturday for; DJ Tennis and Masha Mar rounding out the bill only sweetens it.
enrichment.description: Outdoor block party on Gin Ling Way in Chinatown headlined by Innervisions co-founder Âme, with Life and Death's DJ Tennis, plus Kaz James and Masha Mar.

events.title: FLOAT Rooftop Pool Party feat. Apache [2-8 PM]
events.detail: Poolside beats, curated cocktails, and skyline views above the city.

artist_notes.name: Apache
artist_notes.note: Miami-based, French-born DJ/producer on Abracadabra Records (Miami house/techno label) and founder of the Soundtuary party series — warm, groove-driven house suited to a rooftop-pool crowd.

enrichment.curator_note: A genuine rooftop-pool day party — Apache isn't a name you'll recognize, but Abracadabra's house lane is legit groove, not brostep-adjacent EDM, and the setting alone (2-8pm, DTLA rooftop) is the Sunset-Sessions kind of afternoon you like.
enrichment.description: Daytime rooftop pool party (2-8pm) at Level 8 DTLA headlined by Miami house DJ Apache.

artist_notes.name: DRAMA
artist_notes.note: Chicago R&B/dance duo — producer Na'el Shehade and vocalist Via Rosa — genre-blurring pop/dance/jazz songwriting; played Coachella alongside Frank Ocean and Gorillaz.

enrichment.curator_note: Sofi Tukker at the Greek is a Spotify-core-rotation lock, not a discovery pick — a fun big-room night if you're already a fan, and DRAMA's a genuinely tasteful opener rather than filler.
enrichment.description: Sofi Tukker headlines the Greek Theatre with support from DRAMA, 7:30pm.

artist_notes.name: Gilbert0

enrichment.curator_note: Certified Groovers landing Gene On Earth is a nice get — his Limousine Dream sound is more minimal-and-breaks-leaning than most of the TBA-warehouse bills this month, worth it if you want something a shade weirder than straight house.

artist_notes.note: LA DJ known for soul/funk/jack-leaning house sets — a regular guest at A Club Called Rhonda over the years.

artist_notes.name: Goddollars
artist_notes.note: LA-born (Loren Granich), co-creator and resident DJ of A Club Called Rhonda — has held down all-vinyl disco sets there with partner Paradise for over a decade.

artist_notes.name: Gay Felony
artist_notes.note: LA DJ/producer (Melody Scallion) — extended vinyl sets ranging from soulful/progressive house to hard house and melodic techno; hosts a Dublab radio show.

artist_notes.name: Anastazja
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ (USC grad) who came up through Soulection Radio, played Boiler Room, and recently supported Keinemusik's Rampa — a credential that tracks with the melodic/Keinemusik lane.

artist_notes.name: DJ Minx
artist_notes.note: Detroit house matriarch, Women on Wax founder — tracked artist; deep, soulful, dancefloor-first selection.

artist_notes.name: A Club Called Rhonda
artist_notes.note: LA's own queer disco/house institution (Loren Granic & Gregory Alexander) — the closest thing on this bill to the rooftop-groove lane, all disco edits and drag-flecked chaos rather than a band.

enrichment.curator_note: A Club Called Rhonda is one of the last real queer dance institutions left in LA, and stacking Detroit's DJ Holographic next to their own deep bench of residents (Goddollars, Gay Felony, Colored Craig) plus DJ Minx makes this one of the stronger bills on the whole calendar, not just a queer-night box to check.
enrichment.description: Long-running LA queer club night A Club Called Rhonda at Los Globos, with Detroit house veterans DJ Minx and DJ Holographic plus a deep bill of LA residents.

events.detail: Amelie Lens takes over Grand Park for a dynamic, extended day-to-dusk set spanning techno, acid, trance and more, Belgium style.

artist_notes.name: Amelie Lens
artist_notes.note: Belgian techno star, Exhale label — tracked name; driving, hypnotic peak-time techno with real European club credibility (see also her own Grand Park date this batch).

artist_notes.name: Anastasia Giovani
artist_notes.note: SoCal-raised, now a fixture of LA's underground techno scene (SXTCY resident, founder of the VSCRL event series) — dark, textured, experimental techno sets.

enrichment.curator_note: A dedicated day-to-dusk Amelie Lens set at Grand Park, not a shared festival stage — genuinely the better way to catch her than the HARD Summer slot the same month. Extended techno-into-acid-into-trance from a real headliner in a proper Factory 93 room.
enrichment.description: Factory 93 presents a solo, day-to-dusk Amelie Lens set (techno, acid, trance) at Grand Park Block 2, DTLA.

verdict.why: Amelie Lens solo at Grand Park via Factory 93 — outdoor block-party format, legit promoter, tracked headliner. September date gives time to plan; the RA pick confirms it's already on radar.

artist_notes.name: Rich Medina
artist_notes.note: Philly institution, 25+ years in — founder of Jump n Funk (North America's original Afrobeat party) and one of the great genre-agnostic all-night selectors, moving through house, soul, afrobeat, funk, breaks and rare groove.

enrichment.curator_note: An open-to-close Rich Medina set billed explicitly as house/rare-groove/garage is exactly the deep-crate education worth clearing a whole Saturday night for at a tiki bar like High Tide.
enrichment.description: All-night open-to-close set (10pm) from Philly selector Rich Medina — house, rare groove and garage classics — at High Tide's Little Tokyo/Arts District bar.

events.title: Boiler Room: LA | Sunday
reasons: +4 event card (+3 draw, +1 rare booking, +1 stacked bill)

artist_notes.name: Floorplan
artist_notes.note: Robert Hood & daughter Lyric Hood — Detroit techno royalty (M-Plant) turned deep, gospel-inflected house. 'Baby Baby' fills a floor for a reason.

artist_notes.name: HoneyLuv
artist_notes.note: Cleveland-born, ex-Navy — one of the biggest tech-house breakouts of the last few years; soulful, groovy end of the genre, runs her own 4 Tha Luv label.

artist_notes.name: Hannah Laing
artist_notes.note: Dundee DJ, ex-dental technician turned fast-rising UK name — high-energy trance and hard house, runs the doof label and just launched her own festival.

artist_notes.name: Coco & Breezy
artist_notes.note: Twin sisters (also the eyewear-brand founders) turned house/dance DJ duo — danceable, R&B-tinged, more crossover-pop energy than underground.

artist_notes.name: STRAWBRY
artist_notes.note: LA underground fixture (South Florida-raised) — breaks-and-house sets, runs the STUDIO5400 party series.

artist_notes.name: Vieze Asbak
artist_notes.note: Dutch 'memecore'/troll-rave artist out of Amsterdam's Pestcore Collectief — hard-dance-adjacent chaos, not clean house or techno. A sign this bill gets weird in spots.

artist_notes.name: Jazzy (IRL)
artist_notes.note: Couldn't pin down a confident bio for this one — flagging as unverified rather than guessing.

enrichment.curator_note: Boiler Room's Sunday day party stacks Floorplan's gospel house and HoneyLuv's tech-house heat against Hannah Laing's hard-house hype and a Dutch memecore act, with several names even RA barely has bios for — genuinely one of the most eclectic single-day bills on the radar, go in expecting variety over consistency.
enrichment.description: Boiler Room's LA day party (venue TBA) — a 14-act, multi-genre bill headlined by Floorplan, HoneyLuv, and Hannah Laing.

events.title: The Outsiders (Touring)
events.detail: The winner of four 2024 Tony Awards®, including Best Musical, is THE OUTSIDERS.Adapted from S.E. HINTON’s seminal novel and FRANCIS FORD COPPOLA’s iconic film, this thrilling new musical features a book by ADAM RAPP with JUSTIN LEVINE, music and lyrics by JAMESTOWN REVIVAL (Jonathan Clay & Zach Chance) and Tony Award® winner JUSTIN LEVINE, music supervision, orchestration, and arrangements by JUSTIN LEVINE, choreography by RICK KUPERMAN & JEFF KUPERMAN, and direction by Tony Award® winner DANYA TAYMOR. Entertainment Weekly says, "THE OUTSIDERS has the power to inspire an entire generation."In Tulsa, Oklahoma, 1967, Ponyboy Curtis, his best friend Johnny Cade and their Greaser family of ‘outsiders’ battle with their affluent rivals, the Socs. THE OUTSIDERS navigates the complexities of self- discovery as the Greasers dream about who they want to become in a world that may never accept them. With a dynamic original score, THE OUTSIDERS is a story of friendship, family, belonging…and the realization that there is still “lots of good in the world.”

events.title: Bonnie Raitt: Live 2026 with Special Guest Jon Cleary
lineup: Jon Cleary & the Absolute Monster Gentlemen
events.detail: Bluesy singer/songwriter Bonnie Raitt has worked long and hard for her multiple Grammy Awards, hit singles and chart-topping records. Since her 1971 eponymous debut, the California-born performer and long-time activist has steadily maintained a music career, albeit with definite peaks and valleys. The red-headed songstress, one of the only women of her time to play guitar using the bottleneck technique, unleashed seven albums in just nine years, though her big commercial break came with her 10th studio set, 1989’s “Nick of Time.” That 11-track collection, produced by Don Was, earned three Grammy Awards, including Album of the Year. Not only has the Rock and Roll Hall of Famer tackled multiple U.S. tours and international runs, but she’s also a frequent participant in events of social activism, such as Farm Aid and Amnesty International concerts. Raitt’s 16th full-length album and most recent studio release, “Slipstream,” hit retailers in 2012. Not only did ticket sales for the support tour soar, but Raitt also landed the best-selling blues album of the year and took home the Grammy for Best Americana Album.

artist_notes.name: Derrick Carter
artist_notes.note: Chicago house legend since the late-'80s Warehouse/Muzic Box lineage — co-runs Classic Music Company with Luke Solomon; funky, genre-agnostic, unmistakable house selection still headlining at this level.

artist_notes.name: DJ Sneak
artist_notes.note: Chicago house OG ('the Turntable Terrorist') — jacking, sample-heavy garage-house going back to the early-'90s Cajmere/Relief era, still DJing at that level today.

artist_notes.name: DJ Heather
artist_notes.note: Chicago house DJ, co-founder of the pioneering all-female Superjane crew (with DJ Colette, Dayhota, Lady D) — soulful, genre-blurring sets rooted in Gramaphone Records digging.

artist_notes.name: H-Foundation
artist_notes.note: San Diego duo (Hipp-E & Halo) — dub-inflected deep/tech-house with a Fabric London residency and a Chemical Brothers remix credit to their name; not a frequent LA booking.

artist_notes.name: Hector Moralez
artist_notes.note: Oakland-raised, now LA-based house DJ/producer (Minority Music, The Factory labels) — Chicago/Detroit-rooted, soul-deep selections; a regular in Sneak's LA circle.

artist_notes.name: J-Dub
artist_notes.note: Chicago-bred new-school house DJ and frequent DJ Sneak collaborator on the LA circuit (CHI♡LA, Certified Groovers) — funky, percussive, seamless-blend style.

artist_notes.name: Juliet Mendoza
artist_notes.note: LA-native house DJ and dancer — founder/resident of Jill's House (Jackin Jills), a Defected 'Unsung Heroes' alum; melodic, soulful, deep house rooted in the city's Black/Latin house dance lineage.

artist_notes.name: Masha Mar
artist_notes.note: Serbian-born, LA-based DJ/curator (the Midnight Lovers crew) with NTS and Dublab residencies — Italo disco, house and dancefloor edits.

artist_notes.name: Ian Llorens
artist_notes.note: Certified Groovers resident, LA-based (Puerto Rico-born) — rhythm-forward house/techno selector, also plays as O God / Soundprism.

artist_notes.name: Stacy Christine
artist_notes.note: LA warehouse-scene DJ since 2012 (Music For Dancers, Critter Control, Machine Club lineage) — joyful house into kinetic techno; has opened for DJ Harvey, Moodymann, and Honey Dijon.

enrichment.curator_note: Sneak's birthday parties are always deep, but pulling Derrick Carter, DJ Heather and H-Foundation back into the same room is a real reunion of the Chicago class that built this sound — worth clearing the whole afternoon for, even with the venue still a mystery.
enrichment.description: DJ Sneak's annual birthday day-party (TBA DTLA-area location, Sat 11/14, 4pm) stacks Chicago house legends Derrick Carter, DJ Heather and H-Foundation with LA scene regulars Hector Moralez, J-Dub, Juliet Mendoza, Masha Mar, Ian Llorens and Stacy Christine.
